name: OMTech FC-105SAT
tagline: OMTech FC-105SAT: SAT variant of the FC-105 fiber cutter line
tldr: OMTech FC-105SAT is a variant in the FC-105 fiber family with SAT configuration: same class as FC-105SA for sheet fiber cutting; compare specs on OMTech before choosing SA vs SAT vs T.
mainObjective: FC-105 fiber cutting with SAT configuration

priceRange.note: Official OMTech store, Oct 2026: starting at $169,999 (quote-based; sheet and tube cutting, 1.5 to 6 kW IPG source)

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

pros: Fiber cuts sheet metal: does not cut wood or acrylic
Software listed on the profile: test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
Work area 3000 × 1500 mm (5 × 10 ft): confirm floor space, 3-phase power and loading before you order
cons: Does not cut wood, leather, or acrylic: sheet metal cutting only
Fume extraction still matters for coated metals and marking sprays
beginnerNotes: This profile covers OMTech FC-105SAT. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: Fiber sheet cutting in the FC-105 family.

editorialDepth.advantages: OMTech FC-105SAT is an industrial fiber cutter (1.5–6 kW IPG source, 3000 × 1500 mm bed) for steel, stainless and aluminum parts. It suits fabrication shops that want to bring sheet cutting in-house instead of outsourcing.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip for engraving, wood, leather or acrylic, or without 3-phase 380 V power, assist gas and floor space for a multi-ton machine. Pricing is quote-based and installation is a project of its own.
